To submit a new or suspected pixel walk for review, please send an email to csref@efg.gg using the below format:

Map: Which map is the spot on?
Position on the map: A brief description of where on the map the spot is located? (i.e., next to quad on Inferno)
Example: Either a screenshot or a video of the spot in use (a video of how to access the spot would be very helpful, too)
Comment: Any other comments you'd like to add to support the submission

After reviewing the spot, it will be added to this sheet with a decision of whether it is allowed or disallowed.
